app.title: Voice Reader
setup.title: One step before it can talk
setup.desc: Add a Xiaomi MiMo API key for cloud voices, or make local speech the primary engine.
mixer.model.design.hint: Describe the voice you want in one sentence
mixer.model.clone.hint: Upload an mp3 / wav sample to clone a voice
mixer.voice.hint: The same voice shifts with text and style instruction
mixer.design.placeholder: e.g. Young female, warm and articulate, slower pace, gentle rising endings.
mixer.design.hint: Describe the voice in natural language; the model designs it from the description.
mixer.clone.hint: mp3 / wav, 10-30 s of clean speech, up to 7 MB. Samples stay on this machine.
mixer.clone.empty: No sample yet. Upload a clip to clone a voice.
mixer.clone.badFormat: Voice clone only supports mp3 / wav samples
mixer.clone.tooLarge: The sample is over 7 MB - please use a shorter clip
mixer.clone.emptyContent: Couldn't read the file: it is empty
mixer.instruction.placeholder: Leave empty for the default delivery, e.g. speak in a relaxed, slightly faster tone.
mixer.instruction.hint: Sent as a user message, never spoken. Results vary by model and text.
mixer.rateHint: Changing rate slightly shifts pitch - an inherent effect of speeding up audio.
stage.messages.empty: No assistant reply to read yet.
stage.messages.denied: Reading messages was denied: allow the “messages” privacy scope.
history.empty: No audio yet. Successful synthesis is saved here automatically.
history.storageUnavailable.memory: Local audio library unavailable: {{msg}}; entries are kept in memory only.
history.clearFailed: Clear failed: local audio library unavailable
history.deleteFailed: Delete failed: local audio library unavailable
history.persistFailed: Couldn't save the audio to the local library: {{msg}} (this one can still be previewed in the list)
settings.keyHint: Stored locally in plugin storage, only used for api.xiaomimimo.com requests.
settings.baseUrlHint: Default https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1; compatible relays also work.
settings.range.hint: Smart: auto reads the opening two paragraphs, manual reads all. Full: always all. First: always the first paragraph.
settings.local.hint: Fall back to the built-in browser voice when the cloud fails; local speech ignores style instructions.
settings.sfxHint: Soft cues when playback starts, finishes or fails.
settings.aboutText: Recreates the reading experience of dsh-plugin-xiaomi-mimo-tts on Xiaomi MiMo TTS. Cloud synthesis follows the provider's billing policy; the TTS series is currently free for a limited time.
toast.noKey: Add a MiMo API key in settings first
toast.deleteFailed: Delete failed: local storage is unavailable
toast.tooLong: The text is long - reading only the first {{n}} characters
toast.fallback.useCloud: switched to the MiMo cloud voice
error.audioBlocked: The system hasn't allowed audio yet - click the panel once and try again
error.noLocalVoice: The system provides no local voice
footer.hint.noEngine: The reader engine isn't ready yet, try again in a moment
footer.hint.noKey: No MiMo API key yet — fill it once in the Voice Reader panel
